title: One answer away
technique: Three real camera-move clips and one acting clip, each bound to one beat.
story: A shopper is one click from buying the Fig & Cedar candle.
She wonders if it's safe for her cat; the page doesn't say. She leaves.
The owner sees three sales, decides nobody wants it, and plans to discontinue it.
Scout's orb pops out of her laptop: Don't guess. Ask them.
Scout reaches the shopper; the owner reads why: Wasn't sure it's safe for my cat.
End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
